09:14 to 12:51 is 3 hours 37 minutes later, so subtracting 12:51 from 09:14 means going backwards 3h37m from 09:14.  
09:14 - 3h = 06:14, 06:14 - 37m = 05:37, but since we wrap around 24h, 05:37 is earlier same day.  
Alternatively, 09:14 = 9:14, 12:51 = 12:51.  
(9*60+14) - (12*60+51) = 554 - 771 = -217 minutes.  
-217 + 1440 = 1223 minutes = 20 hours 23 minutes.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 20:23
